notes.title: Control Update live! yay :-)
notes.notes:
Ok soooo, you now have control over thrust and firing! A new toggle button has been added to the main menu, if its lit your in auto fire thrust mode, if not you can manual thrust and fire with your 360 controller or keyboard control. (shift/z/space to fire and up to thrust) please share any thoughts/bugs ect

cheers
Kingsguard

notes.title: Releaseday!
notes.notes:
Hi Steam Gamers, Hope you enjoy Troid Blaster! This Game is my attempt at mixing the minimalism of downwell with the fun of asteroids and putting it all in a physics universe. The idea is to make the best 2d asteroids game out, but not with super 3d graphics but rather pure nuaced gameplay. Troid blaster is a simple game to control, simply left and right on your controler or left and right arrow keys, but you can do a lot with it as the ship moves with inertia and all colisions are based on physics.

In the old asteroids if you touch an asteroid you die, Troid blaster measures your speed, weight, inertia and creates complex collision stats that then factor into what happens, if its slow or your ship is light you will bounce a bit, heavy ships fast colisions can mean insta-death.

Anyways i could yabber on all day about the concept, but i hope you all enjoy it! If i sell enough i will make an ultimate sequel. If you have a mo please take a look at my in develpment game on greenlight Interstellar rogue.

Good day to you all!
KingsGuard
